Pose - One Hand on Hip.description:
🕴️ Pose: One Hand on Hip
Standing with one hand resting on the hip — a confident, slightly assertive casual stance.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Pose - One Hand on Hip.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Within the selected Portrait Framing, rest one frame-visible hand at the hip with the elbow angled outward, keep the other visible arm relaxed, and shift the torso subtly toward the supported side. Female: the hand sits at the waist and the hip cants. Male: the hand sits at the hip with weight even. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own hip line.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
